he.name: Transforming Fire to Water

en.name: Transforming Fire to Water
en.detailMedium: Mixed technique on paper · original artwork
en.description: Fire and water meet within a single structure, transforming one another. The piece reflects on energy's ability to change form without losing its essence.
en.alt: Transforming Fire to Water, a symmetrical image of fire and water
